text:
Mia Chen: Heads up — customers on Dedicated are reporting p99 jumps to ~3.2s for requests routed to needle-1.0 after yesterday's onboarding. Not all requests, skewed to long-context (>8k) calls.
Raj Patel: seeing same in dashboards. spike started ~1718509000, coincides with the needle rollout. p95 up too but p99 is noisier.
Lucas Romero: any 5xx or auth errors?
Mia Chen: mostly 200s but higher latencies. A few 502s from auth-proxy timed out behind the LB. Attach logs.
Mia Chen: ```
# excerpt from routing logs
2024-05-05T10:05:12Z route=dedicated-03 model=needle-1.0 latency_ms=3200 path=/v1/generate
2024-05-05T10:05:12Z authproxy=timeout duration_ms=3001 user=acct-123
```
Tina Park: interesting — needle changed tokenizer to subword-v3 which increases token count for CJK and long-prompt clients. Could that blow up header/body sizes or KV cache lookups?
Raj Patel: hypothesis: increased token count => longer KV cache iterations in runtime => longer worker hold => auth proxy connection times out waiting for response. Also saw per-request memory allocations higher.
Lucas Romero: repro steps? I can try local repro with long prompt.
Mia Chen: short repro we used: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"needle-1.0","input":"'"`printf 'a%.0s' {1..12000}`"' , "max_tokens":4096 }'
```
Mia Chen: with subword-v3 we see tokenized length ~13k tokens vs 8k previously. p99 jumps locally from 400ms to 2.8s.
support-oncall: noted. escalating to infra. tagging @infra-bot. :rotating_light:
infra-bot: Assigned: #INC-5981. Priority: high. Notifying eng-runtime and eng-ml.
Tina Park: quick mitigation options: (1) pin needle to tokenizer=subword-v2 for Dedicated customers until we optimize; (2) add short-term increase to auth-proxy timeout to 6s; (3) enable model fallback to needle-0.9 for requests >8k tokens.
Raj Patel: prefer (2)+(3) immediately, (1) as follow-up if (2) not enough. Changing timeouts is fastest.
Lucas Romero: I'm worried increasing timeout hides root cause and could exhaust connections under pressure. Suggest also limited concurrency per-worker for needle-1.0 and soft-reject (>12k tokens) with a clear error message.
Mia Chen: Agreed. Action plan: 1) infra to bump auth-proxy client timeout from 3s->6s for needle routes (Tina/Raj) 2) platform to add fallback policy: if tokenized_length > 9000 then route to needle-0.9 (Lucas/Tina) 3) eng-runtime to profile KV cache loop for needle tokenizer hotpath (Lucas) 4) notify affected customers with mitigation steps (Mia).
Raj Patel: I'll apply timeout in prod dev ring now. Pushing config change to edge-proxy-roles.
Tina Park: added fallback rule in routing config template, staging deploy pass. snippet: ```
route:
  - match: model==needle-1.0 and tokenized_len > 9000
    action: route_to("needle-0.9")
```
Mia Chen: sent email to top 5 impacted accounts and posted in #customer-ops with recommended client changes (split long prompts, enable streaming).
support-oncall: customer replies: one account reported transient 502s resolved after we increased timeout. another asked for ETA on tokenizer fix.
Lucas Romero: early profiling results: needle subword-v3 tokenization adds ~45% more token boundaries and causes extra KV lookups in runtime due to chunk alignments. There is also an edge-case in our KV iterator that does O(n^2) work for certain long sequences — will send PR to fix.
Mia Chen: do we need to rollback the model to needle-0.9 temporarily for Dedicated customers?
Tina Park: let's avoid full rollback unless we see error rate increase. Fallback + timeout + concurrency cap should be sufficient for now. Also recommend making tokenizer change opt-in per-tenant for next rollouts.
Raj Patel: prod timeout change is live for ring-1. Monitoring p99 now.
infra-bot: Metric update: ring-1 p99 for needle-1.0 dropped from 3.1s -> 1.6s after timeout bump + fallback. CPU per-worker slightly higher.
Mia Chen: good improvement. Lucas can you target PR for KV iterator fix by EOD? We want to cut a patch before we expand rollout.
Lucas Romero: yes — PR #4827 open, includes test that reproduces O(n^2) with long identical-subtoken sequences. Requesting review.
Tina Park: I'll prepare a postmortem template and include customer impact numbers and mitigation timeline.
Mia Chen: customer comms draft posted in #customer-ops, asking for approval. cc @Tina Park @Raj Patel.
support-oncall: closing the incident ticket once PR merged and ring-2 rollout shows stable p99 for 24h.
Mia Chen: thanks all. follow-up: introduce per-model tokenization telemetry to catch token-inflation early in future rollouts. :white_check_mark:
